unique_device_contracts AS (
SELECT c.id, c.tenant_id, c.contract_no, c.company_code FROM com_contract c JOIN device_filter_contract_keys k ON k.contract_key = CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = b'0'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM com_contract duplicate_contract WHERE duplicate_contract.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND duplicate_contract.deleted = b'0' AND duplicate_contract.contract_no = c.contract_no AND duplicate_contract.id <> c.id )
SELECT MAX(id) AS id, MAX(tenant_id) AS tenant_id, contract_no, MAX(company_code) AS company_code FROM com_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' GROUP BY contract_no HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
), visible_device_contracts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AS contract_key FROM unique_device_contracts c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND c.contract_no <> '' AND 1 = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM com_shipment_contract_reference shipment WHERE shipment.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND shipment.deleted = b'0' AND shipment.contract_no = c.contract_no AND (shipment.company_code IS NULL OR shipment.company_code = '' OR CAST(shipment.company_code AS BINARY) <> CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)) ) AND (
CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{companyCode} AS BINARY) OR
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation pcr JOIN visible_projects vp ON vp.project_id = pcr.project_id WHERE pcr.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND pcr.contract_id = c.id AND pcr.deleted = b'0' AND pcr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pcr.effective_to IS NULL ) ) )
